reason: I run everything from Telegram and a notebook and it works. You are new, with almost no paying companies and no references, and you want my whole client list on your server.
objection: Is my customer data safe on your server, and are there backups? If you vanish in a year, I lose my clients. A second backup location is only a promise until it is done.
would_change_my_mind: Talking to two or three real owners like me who have used it for months and still use it, plus a clear written promise that I can export all my data any time.
